Amazon's cost of sales rose about 36.5% from fiscal Q1 2023 to fiscal Q4 2023. The Q4 figure is not reported directly, so I derived it by subtracting the nine-month 2023 total from the full-year total.

- **Q1 2023 cost of sales:** $67,791 million, from the Q1 2024 10-Q.
- **Q4 2023 cost of sales:** full-year 2023 of $304,739 million minus the nine-month 2023 total of $212,186 million, which gives $92,553 million.
- **Change:** ($92,553 − $67,791) / $67,791 = $24,762 / $67,791 ≈ 36.5%.
